name: Fouquet's Mykonos
insider_take: Where Parisian elegance meets Cycladic charm on one of Greece's most glamorous islands
whats_special: This luxury resort brings the legendary sophistication of Paris's famous Fouquet's restaurant to Mykonos, featuring stunning infinity pools overlooking the Aegean Sea and suites with private terraces. The property sits on a prime hillside location offering panoramic views of the island's iconic windmills and dramatic sunsets that have made Mykonos a bucket-list destination.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the hotel's terrace restaurant during the golden hour – you'll have front-row seats to one of the Mediterranean's most spectacular light shows without fighting the crowds at the famous windmills.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature spa treatments using local Greek ingredients, and the exclusive beach club access to avoid the notoriously crowded public beaches. Take advantage of the concierge's connections to secure tables at Mykonos' hottest restaurants like Nammos and Scorpios, which book up months in advance during peak season.
pros: Breathtaking Aegean Sea views with stunning sunsets over the iconic Mykonos landscape
Legendary Fouquet's dining legacy brought to Greece, offering world-class French-Mediterranean cuisine
Luxurious Cycladic-inspired design featuring private pools and lavish suite accommodations
Exceptional personalized service with dedicated concierge access to exclusive island experiences
Prime location offering easy access to Mykonos's vibrant nightlife, beaches, and cultural landmarks
cons: Adults-only property, not suitable for families with children
Ultra-luxury pricing places it among the most exclusive and expensive stays on the island
